instrument: Resolution on biotechnology development to 2030, vision 2045

instrument: Resolution on biotechnology development to 2030, vision 2045

target_text_en: Develop and modernise biotech in processing industry to make safe, high-value products from domestic raw materials

instrument: Government action programme for Resolution 36-NQ/TW

Parallel schemes for industry (MOIT, Q4 2024), health (MOH, Q4 2024), environment (MONRE, Q2 2024), standards and IP (MOST, Q4 2024), human resources (MOET, Q2 2024), genetic resources programme 2026 to 2030 (Q1 2025). Delivery status of each not verified.

target_text_en: Patent applications and grants grow 16 to 18% a year; commercialisation rate 8 to 10%

instrument: Resolution on breakthroughs in science, technology, innovation and national digital transformation

instrument: Resolution on breakthroughs in science, technology, innovation and national digital transformation

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Thu nhập bình quân của người dân nông thôn năm 2030 phấn đấu tăng gấp 2,5 - 3 lần so với năm 2020
target_text_en: Average rural income in 2030 2.5 to 3 times the 2020 level
notes: Macro input for diet change (income-driven demand).

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Tỉ lệ che phủ rừng ổn định ở mức 42%
target_text_en: Forest cover stable at 42%

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: bảo vệ nghiêm ngặt quỹ đất chuyên lúa, hằng năm sản xuất ít nhất 35 triệu tấn lúa để bảo đảm an ninh lương thực quốc gia

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: nâng cao năng lực tự chủ trong sản xuất thức ăn chăn nuôi

instrument: Resolution on agriculture, farmers and rural areas to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Nông nghiệp sinh thái, sản xuất hàng hoá quy mô lớn, có giá trị gia tăng cao, công nghiệp chế biến và bảo quản nông sản hiện đại, xuất khẩu nhiều loại nông sản đứng hàng đầu thế giới
target_text_en: Ecological agriculture, large-scale commodity production with high value added, modern processing and storage, many farm exports among the world leaders
notes: Vision. No protein-specific language.

instrument: Conclusion on continuing Resolution 19-NQ/TW; Government action programme
target_text_vi: Chiến lược tài nguyên nước quốc gia đến năm 2030 tầm nhìn đến năm 2050
target_text_en: New national water resources strategy to 2030, vision 2050 (MAE, 2026); circular-economy models scheme (MAE, 2026); Mekong subsidence, erosion and salinity scheme (2026 to 2027)
notes: Resolution 85/NQ-CP has no new numeric targets per our read; 25 tasks to 2030. Water strategy and Mekong scheme not yet found as issued.

instrument: Sustainable agriculture and rural development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Tốc độ tăng trưởng GDP nông lâm thủy sản: 2,5 - 3%/năm
target_text_en: Agriculture, forestry and fisheries GDP growth 2.5 to 3% a year
notes: Also: labour productivity growth 5.5 to 6% a year; export value growth 5 to 6% a year; trained labour over 70%.

instrument: Sustainable agriculture and rural development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Phấn đấu giảm phát thải khí nhà kính 10% so với năm 2020
target_text_en: Reduce agricultural greenhouse gas emissions by 10% against 2020
notes: Softer than the Decision 896 agriculture cap (64 MtCO2e in 2030, about 39% below 2020 by CLM calculation). The two texts use different bases (2020 actual vs BAU); see disagreements log.

instrument: Sustainable agriculture and rural development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Chủ động trong việc cung ứng các đầu vào thiết yếu (giống, thức ăn, thuốc)
target_text_en: Be self-reliant in supplying essential inputs (seed stock, feed, veterinary drugs)
notes: Fisheries section. No feed self-sufficiency ratio.

instrument: Sustainable agriculture and rural development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Phát triển công nghệ chế biến sâu, công nghệ bảo quản, giảm tổn thất, lãng phí trong hệ thống lương thực, thực phẩm
target_text_en: Develop deep processing and storage technology; reduce food loss and waste
notes: Also 'đẩy mạnh chế biến sâu, tận dụng phụ phẩm' (deep processing, use of by-products).

instrument: Sustainable agriculture and rural development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Phấn đấu Việt Nam trở thành một trong những nước có nền nông nghiệp hàng đầu thế giới với ngành công nghiệp chế biến nông sản hiện đại
target_text_en: Vietnam among the world's leading agricultural nations with a modern, efficient, environmentally friendly processing industry
notes: The only 2050 statement in the text. No numeric 2050 targets.

instrument: Livestock development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: chăn nuôi Việt Nam là ngành kinh tế kỹ thuật hiện đại
target_text_en: Vietnamese livestock is a modern economic-technical sector, industrialised in most stages

instrument: Livestock development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: thuộc nhóm đầu của các nước khu vực Đông Nam Á
target_text_en: Livestock production level and capacity among the leading group in Southeast Asia

instrument: Livestock development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: trên 70% khối lượng sản phẩm chăn nuôi chính được qua sơ chế, chế biến công nghiệp, trong đó khoảng 30% được chế biến sâu
target_text_en: Over 70% of main livestock products pass through industrial preliminary processing or processing; about 30% deeply processed
notes: Industrial processing capacity is also the manufacturing base for hybrid meat and plant-based products.

instrument: Livestock development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: 100% sản phẩm thịt gia súc, gia cầm hàng hóa được cung cấp từ các cơ sở giết mổ tập trung, công nghiệp
target_text_en: 100% of marketed livestock and poultry meat from concentrated, industrial slaughterhouses
metric: Share of meat from industrial slaughter

instrument: Livestock development strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: bã, men bia, bã dứa, bã sắn, tiết và phụ phẩm lò mổ, vỏ đầu tôm, đầu xương và mỡ cá tra
target_text_en: Use by-products as feed: spent grain, brewer's yeast, pineapple pulp, cassava pulp, blood and slaughter by-products, shrimp heads and shells, pangasius bones and fat

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: sản lượng nuôi trồng thủy sản 7,0 triệu tấn
target_text_en: Aquaculture output 7.0 Mt
notes: Main driver of aquafeed and fishmeal demand. At a feed conversion ratio of about 1.3 to 1.5 on fed species this is a large aquafeed requirement; the balance model (QNT) should use it.

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: sản lượng khai thác thủy sản 2,8 triệu tấn
target_text_en: Capture output 2.8 Mt, with gradual reduction of fishing effort
notes: Also 'Giảm dần cường lực khai thác' (gradually reduce fishing effort). Caps domestic trash fish and fishmeal raw material.

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Giá trị kim ngạch xuất khẩu thủy sản đạt 14 - 16 tỷ USD
target_text_en: Seafood exports USD 14 to 16 billion
notes: Growth rate of production value 3.0 to 4.0% a year; over 3.5 million jobs; post-harvest losses below 10%.

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Chủ động sản xuất thức ăn công nghiệp thay thế việc sử dụng cá tạp
target_text_en: Produce industrial feed to replace the use of trash fish
notes: No fishmeal or alternative-protein target. Replacing trash fish raises demand for formulated protein.

instrument: Fisheries development strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: thuộc nhóm ba nước sản xuất và xuất khẩu thủy sản dẫn đầu thế giới
target_text_en: Among the world's top three seafood producers and exporters; a centre of deep seafood processing
notes: Vision. No 2045 volume target.

instrument: National green growth strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Cường độ phát thải khí nhà kính trên GDP giảm ít nhất 15% so với năm 2014
target_text_en: GHG emission intensity of GDP at least 15% below 2014
notes: The brief named Decision 882/QD-TTg; that is the 2022 National Action Plan on Green Growth implementing this strategy. The strategy itself is Decision 1658/QD-TTg.

instrument: National green growth strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Cường độ phát thải khí nhà kính trên GDP giảm ít nhất 30% so với năm 2014
target_text_en: GHG emission intensity of GDP at least 30% below 2014
status: in force (superseded in ambition by the 2050 net-zero pledge)
notes: Intensity target far weaker than net zero 2050 in Decision 896 (CLM-01). Treat 896 as the binding climate reference.

instrument: National green growth strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Tỷ trọng năng lượng tái tạo đạt 15 - 20% tổng cung cấp năng lượng sơ cấp
target_text_en: Renewables 15 to 20% of total primary energy supply (2030); 25 to 30% (2050)
metric: Renewable share of primary energy supply
status: in force (overtaken by PDP8 revised for power)
notes: Primary energy, not electricity; not comparable with the PDP8 non-hydro renewable power share (74 to 75% of generation in 2050, FTG-15).

instrument: National green growth strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: ít nhất 60% tổng diện tích cây trồng cạn có tưới được áp dụng phương pháp tưới tiên tiến, tiết kiệm nước
target_text_en: At least 30% (2030) and 60% (2050) of irrigated upland crop area uses advanced water-saving irrigation
metric: Share of irrigated upland crop area with water-saving irrigation
notes: Relevant to maize, soybean and cassava feedstock water use.

instrument: National green growth strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Tỷ lệ che phủ rừng ổn định ở mức 42 - 43%
target_text_en: Forest cover stable at 42% (2030) and 42 to 43% (2050)
notes: Consistent with Resolution 19. Limits land conversion for feed crops to 2050.

instrument: National action plan on food systems transformation to 2030
target_text_vi: Phát thải khí nhà kính từ hệ thống lương thực thực phẩm giảm 10% so với năm 2020

notes: Carried in v0.1 (ET-17 in CLM); re-read here.

instrument: National action plan on food systems transformation to 2030
target_text_vi: Tỷ lệ giá trị nông sản chế biến trong tổng giá trị sản xuất ở mức trên 50%

instrument: National action plan on food systems transformation to 2030

notes: Loss reduction frees side streams but no target converts them to protein.

instrument: National action plan on food systems transformation to 2030
target_text_vi: Tỷ lệ suy dinh dưỡng thấp còi ở trẻ em dưới 5 tuổi ở mức dưới 15%
target_text_en: Stunting under 5 below 15%; wasting below 3%; overweight under 5 below 10%, age 5 to 18 below 19%, adults 19 to 64 below 20%
notes: Demand-side macro context only. No protein-intake target in this plan; no mention of plant-based or new foods.

instrument: National action plan on food systems transformation to 2030
target_text_vi: Duy trì kim ngạch xuất khẩu lương thực thực phẩm trên 30 tỷ đô la Mỹ/năm
target_text_en: Keep agrifood exports above USD 30 billion a year; households with moderate or severe food insecurity below 5%
unit: USD billion per year; % of households
notes: Organic land at least 2.5%; organic fertiliser over 30% of supply; over 30% of value under good practices.

instrument: National action plan on circular economy to 2035
target_text_vi: Vật liệu, sản phẩm, phụ phẩm, chất thải và dịch vụ có tiềm năng
target_text_en: Agriculture (crops, livestock, forestry, fisheries) listed as a priority sector for circular models: by-products, livestock by-products and manure, aquaculture by-products and waste
status: in force (implements Decision 687/QD-TTg 2022, which stays in force)
notes: No numeric target for side-stream reuse in agriculture. Cross-cutting 2030 targets: GHG intensity at least 15% below 2014; biomass power 2,270 MW; urban solid waste 95% collected and treated. A '47% renewables in primary energy' figure returned by extraction conflicts with Decision 1658 (15 to 20%); not used.

instrument: Mekong Delta regional plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Phát triển các sản phẩm chiến lược theo ba trọng tâm: Thủy sản, trái cây và lúa gạo
target_text_en: Strategic products in the order: aquatic products, fruit, rice (shift away from rice towards aquaculture and fruit)
status: in force (regional plan; not yet re-issued for the merged provinces as far as we found)
notes: Agriculture, forestry and fisheries about 20% of regional GRDP in 2030; GRDP growth about 6.5% a year; adaptation by three ecological sub-zones (fresh, brackish, saline). Aquaculture growth implies more aquafeed demand in the delta.

instrument: Mekong Delta regional plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: tăng tỷ lệ che phủ rừng đến năm 2030 đạt 7,5%

notes: Single extraction; not cross-checked.

instrument: National master plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050 (as amended)
target_text_vi: Tổ chức không gian phát triển đất nước thành 06 vùng kinh tế - xã hội
target_text_en: Six socio-economic regions after the 2025 provincial merger (Mekong Delta as sustainable agricultural economic centre)
notes: Res 81 original: Mekong Delta to become a centre of sustainable agricultural economy.

instrument: National master plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Tỷ lệ lao động nông nghiệp trong tổng lao động xã hội giảm xuống dưới 20%
target_text_en: Farm labour below 20% of employment; urbanisation above 50%
notes: Urbanisation drives processed and away-from-home food demand.

instrument: National land use plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050 (adjusted)

instrument: National land use plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050 (adjusted)

instrument: National nutrition strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045

instrument: National nutrition strategy 2021 to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Chiều cao trung bình thanh niên 18 tuổi theo giới tăng từ 2-2,5cm đối với nam và 1,5-2 cm đối với nữ
target_text_en: Average height of 18-year-olds up 2 to 2.5 cm (male) and 1.5 to 2 cm (female) against 2020
notes: Height goals imply more high-quality protein and dairy in child diets (our reading). 2045 vision: 'Mọi người dân đạt được tình trạng dinh dưỡng tối ưu' (optimal nutrition for all); no numbers.

instrument: Resolution on breakthroughs in health protection and care
target_text_vi: tăng chiều cao trung bình của trẻ em và thanh thiếu niên từ 1 - 18 tuổi thêm tối thiểu 1,5cm
target_text_en: Children and youth aged 1 to 18: average height up at least 1.5 cm; life expectancy 75.5 years; healthy life years at least 68
metric: Height; life expectancy; healthy life years
notes: 2045: life expectancy above 80, healthy life years above 71. Nutrition 'bảo đảm cân đối về khẩu phần' but no protein norm. Ageing and longevity shape protein demand composition (macro input).

instrument: Resolution on private economy development
target_text_vi: Phấn đấu có 2 triệu doanh nghiệp hoạt động trong nền kinh tế, 20 doanh nghiệp hoạt động/nghìn dân
target_text_en: 2 million enterprises (20 per 1,000 people); private sector 55 to 58% of GDP and growth of 10 to 12% a year; at least 20 large firms in global value chains; technology capability in top 3 of ASEAN
status: in force (Gov action plan Res 138/NQ-CP; NA Res 198/2025/QH15)
notes: Relevant as investment climate: R&D costs deductible at 200% for CIT; firms may set aside up to 20% of taxable income for an S&T fund (quoted by extraction; check against Law 67/2025 and Decree 320/2025).

instrument: Resolution on private economy development
target_text_vi: Có ít nhất 3 triệu doanh nghiệp hoạt động trong nền kinh tế; đóng góp khoảng trên 60% GDP
target_text_en: At least 3 million enterprises; private sector over 60% of GDP
notes: Vision.

instrument: Resolution on national energy security to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Tỉ lệ năng lượng tái tạo trong tổng cung năng lượng sơ cấp khoảng 25 - 30%
target_text_en: Renewables about 25 to 30% of total primary energy supply; TPES about 150 to 170 Mtoe; electricity generation about 560 to 624 TWh
metric: Renewable share of TPES; TPES; power generation
notes: Raises the 2030 renewables-in-primary-energy ambition well above Decision 1658 (15 to 20%). Energy GHG 15 to 35% below BAU; refineries meet at least 70% of fuel demand. Extraction; not cross-checked.

instrument: Resolution on national energy security to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Thử nghiệm mô hình sản xuất, sử dụng năng lượng hydrogen, các dẫn xuất hydrogen, amoniac
target_text_en: Pilot hydrogen, hydrogen-derivative and ammonia production and use, linked to offshore wind and solar; urgently build Ninh Thuan 1 and 2 nuclear (now Khanh Hoa); flexible-scale nuclear including SMRs
notes: Consistent with Decision 165/QD-TTg hydrogen targets (100 to 500 kt in 2030; 10 to 20 Mt in 2050; FTG-16).

instrument: Resolution on national energy security to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Xây dựng giá năng lượng minh bạch do thị trường quyết định, có sự quản lý của Nhà nước
target_text_en: Market-determined, transparent energy prices under state management; end cross-subsidies between customer groups; customer choice of supplier
notes: Ending cross-subsidy could raise industrial power tariffs relative to residential; relevant to fermentation plant opex (our reading, not a projection).

instrument: Assignment of strategic technology development tasks
target_text_vi: Phát triển giống cây trồng, vật nuôi, thủy sản thế hệ mới
target_text_en: MAE to lead next-generation crop, livestock and aquaculture breeds (gene editing, cell technology, precision breeding) and self-reliance in next-generation veterinary vaccines and biologicals, 2026 to 2030
notes: Of 20 strategic technology missions to 2030 we found none on fermentation, microbial or alternative protein, recombinant food ingredients or biomanufacturing for food and feed. No 2035 horizon.

instrument: Science, technology and innovation development strategy to 2030 (adjusted)
target_text_vi: Tổng đầu tư xã hội cho nghiên cứu và phát triển (R&D) đạt tối thiểu 2% GDP
target_text_en: R&D at least 2% of GDP; 12 FTE researchers per 10,000 people; GII in top 40; high-tech exports at least 50% of merchandise exports; 5 to 10 regional-scale firms in strategic technologies
metric: R&D share of GDP; researchers; GII rank
status: in force (adjustment aligns the 2022 strategy with Res 57)
notes: No biotech, agriculture or food mention found in the adjusted text.

instrument: Crop production development strategy to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Giữ ổn định diện tích 3,56 triệu ha đất trồng lúa ... sản lượng trên 35 triệu tấn thóc
target_text_en: Keep rice land stable at 3.56 million ha; paddy output above 35 Mt
status: in force (rice land figure overtaken by Decision 1177/QD-TTg 2026: 3.25 million ha)
notes: Crop production value growth 2.2 to 2.5% a year; organic area 1%. No area or output number for maize, soybean or cassava ('Ổn định diện tích trồng sắn'). Encourages 'ngô sinh khối làm thức ăn chăn nuôi' (maize silage for feed) and feed-firm contracts with farmers. No feed-import reduction target.

instrument: Crop production development strategy to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: Phấn đấu đến năm 2050 trồng trọt thành ngành kinh tế kỹ thuật hiện đại
target_text_en: By 2050 crop production becomes a modern economic-technical sector
notes: No numeric 2050 targets.

instrument: Scheme to develop the feed processing industry to 2030
target_text_vi: Sản lượng thức ăn chăn nuôi công nghiệp đạt 24 - 25 triệu tấn vào năm 2025
target_text_en: Industrial livestock feed output 24 to 25 Mt in 2025 and 30 to 32 Mt in 2030
notes: Not in the v0.1 register. Covers livestock feed only (not aquafeed), which answers the ch30 question of scope for the 30 to 32 Mt figure in favour of livestock and poultry feed. No vision beyond 2030.

instrument: Scheme to develop the feed processing industry to 2030
target_text_vi: cung cấp khoảng 20 - 25% nhu cầu vào năm 2025 và 30 - 35% vào năm 2030
target_text_en: Domestically produced feed additives supply about 20 to 25% of demand in 2025 and 30 to 35% in 2030
metric: Domestic share of feed additive demand
notes: The only quantified import-substitution target for a biotech-type feed input we found. Additives include microbial preparations, enzymes, botanicals and minerals. Aligns with Res 36 (50% biotech import replacement) but is lower.

instrument: Scheme to develop the feed processing industry to 2030
target_text_vi: Tận dụng tối đa và nâng cao giá trị sử dụng các nguồn phụ phẩm nông nghiệp, công nghiệp
target_text_en: Maximise use and value of agricultural, industrial and food-processing by-products for feed; total scheme budget VND 1,310 billion for 2023 to 2030 (VND 350 billion 2023 to 2025; VND 960 billion 2026 to 2030), of which about VND 700 billion for by-product processing
notes: About USD 50 million in total at about VND 26,000 per USD (our conversion). Budget split per extraction; check the appendix. No explicit mention of microbial protein or protein-rich raw materials such as fishmeal or soybean meal.

instrument: National climate change strategy to 2050
target_text_vi: mục tiêu phát thải ròng bằng '0' vào năm 2050
target_text_en: Net-zero emissions by 2050; national emissions peak in 2035
notes: Caps by sector are in CLM emissions_targets.csv (ET-01 to ET-07); not duplicated here except agriculture.

instrument: National climate change strategy to 2050
target_text_vi: lĩnh vực nông nghiệp giảm 63,1%, lượng phát thải không vượt quá 56 triệu tấn CO2tđ
target_text_en: Agriculture emissions no more than 64 MtCO2e in 2030 (43.0% below BAU) and 56 MtCO2e in 2050 (63.1% below BAU)
notes: Cross-checked with CLM ET-03 and ET-04: identical. About 39% and 46% below 2020 actual (CLM calculation).

instrument: National climate change strategy to 2050
target_text_vi: giảm 40% mức phát thải khí mê-tan so với năm 2030
target_text_en: Methane at least 30% below 2020 by 2030; 40% lower by 2050 (base year read as 2030 in two extractions)
notes: CLM ET-07 flagged the 2050 base year as ambiguous. If the base is 2030, 2050 methane would be about 58% below 2020 (our arithmetic: 0.7 x 0.6 = 0.42). See disagreements log.

instrument: National climate change strategy to 2050
target_text_vi: cải thiện khẩu phần thức ăn trong chăn nuôi
target_text_en: Improve livestock feed rations; treat manure into organic fertiliser and biogas; sustainable farm, forest and fisheries value chains
notes: Official mitigation levers are rations, manure and biogas. No mention of alternative or low-emission protein or of diet shift.

instrument: Hydrogen energy development strategy to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: công suất sản xuất hydrogen ... đạt khoảng 10 - 20 triệu tấn/năm vào năm 2050
target_text_en: Clean hydrogen production capacity about 100 to 500 kt a year in 2030 and 10 to 20 Mt a year in 2050; hydrogen and derivatives about 10% of final energy demand in 2050
metric: Hydrogen production capacity; share of final energy
unit: per year; per year; % of final energy
notes: Matches FTG vn_energy_inputs_2050.csv. Uses named: fertiliser, refining, steel, cement, transport, power co-firing. No food, feed or biological use; no cost target. Hydrogen-oxidising bacteria for protein are absent from the strategy.

instrument: Power development plan VIII (revised)
target_text_vi: tỷ lệ năng lượng tái tạo lên đến 74 - 75%
target_text_en: Non-hydro renewables about 28 to 36% of power in 2030 and 74 to 75% in 2050
notes: Matches FTG and v0.1.

instrument: Power development plan VIII (revised)
target_text_vi: công suất nguồn điện gió ngoài khơi để sản xuất năng lượng mới vào khoảng 15.000 MW vào năm 2035
target_text_en: Offshore wind to produce new energy (hydrogen, green ammonia) about 15 GW by 2035 and about 240 GW by 2050
metric: Offshore wind capacity for new energy
notes: The largest single potential source of cheap hydrogen for power-to-protein in 2050, if built. FTG notes no legal track yet for non-grid offshore wind.

instrument: Power development plan VIII (revised)
target_text_vi: nguồn điện sinh khối khoảng 1.523 - 2.699 MW
target_text_en: Biomass power about 1,523 to 2,699 MW in 2030 and about 4,829 to 6,960 MW in 2050
notes: Biomass power competes with feed and fermentation for crop residues (rice straw and husk, bagasse, cassava stems). Decision 222/2025 cites 2,270 MW for 2030, inside this range.

instrument: National AI strategy to 2030, vision 2045
target_text_vi: Chuyển đổi hoạt động sản xuất nông nghiệp bằng AI trong lai tạo giống, trồng trọt, chăn nuôi, thủy sản
target_text_en: About 1,100 EFLOPS (FP8) of AI compute; at least 10,000 advanced AI experts; AI economy about 6% of GDP; AI in breeding, crops, livestock and aquaculture
metric: AI compute; AI experts; AI economy share
notes: Reused from FTB (legal-database summary; full text not read by FTB or NTS). No AI-for-protein or biodesign line.

instrument: Directive on developing biotechnology as an important economic-technical sector
target_text_vi: ngành kinh tế - kỹ thuật quan trọng
target_text_en: MOST to complete special mechanisms and pilot models (by May 2026); MAE to lead biotechnology clusters linking research, production, processing and commercialisation (by December 2026)
notes: Reused from FTB. The December 2026 MAE cluster plan is the nearest window to add a fermentation or feed-protein cluster.

instrument: National biotechnology strategy 2026 to 2030, vision 2045 (draft)
target_text_vi: tin sinh học và trí tuệ nhân tạo
target_text_en: Draft names four priority sectors including bioinformatics and AI; no mention of synthetic biology, biofoundries, fermentation or alternative protein in the workshop report
notes: Reused from FTB. We found no issued national biotech strategy or national biotech industry programme on thuvienphapluat as of 24 Sep 2026.

instrument: Nationally determined contribution 3.0 (2026 to 2035)
target_text_vi: n/a (not published)
target_text_en: No NDC 3.0 found as approved or submitted; draft energy cap for 2035 reported at 380.2 to 519.1 MtCO2e; agriculture pathways to be updated
notes: Checked thuvienphapluat and UNDP Climate Promise on 24 Sep 2026: latest submitted NDC is the November 2022 update. First official 2035 agriculture numbers will come from NDC 3.0.

instrument: Government action programme for the 14th Party Congress resolution (updated)
target_text_vi: nước phát triển, thu nhập cao
target_text_en: Double-digit growth 2026 to 2030; upper-middle-income country with modern industry by 2030; developed high-income country by 2045; digital, smart, green and circular agriculture; national food security
notes: No numeric agriculture or protein target found in the extraction.

instrument: Water resources master plan 2021 to 2030, vision 2050
target_text_vi: nhu cầu sử dụng nước đến năm 2030 khoảng 122,5 tỷ m³/năm, đến năm 2050 khoảng 131,7 tỷ m³/năm
target_text_en: National water demand about 122.5 billion m3 a year in 2030 and about 131.7 billion m3 in 2050; restrict groundwater extraction; supply losses cut to 10%
status: in force (new national water resources strategy to 2050 due in 2026 under Res 85/NQ-CP)
notes: Sector split not extracted. Groundwater restriction matters for Mekong fermentation and aquaculture sites (subsidence; CLM-13, CLM-14).

instrument: National strategy on innovative start-ups
target_text_vi: Quy mô thị trường vốn đầu tư mạo hiểm đạt 1,5 tỷ USD
target_text_en: At least 10,000 innovative start-ups; at least 5 valued at USD 1 billion or more; venture capital market USD 1.5 billion; 300 innovation spaces (2030). 2045: at least 100 start-ups valued at USD 100 million or more; venture capital market USD 10 billion; top 30 globally
notes: Priority sectors named are digital, green and circular; agriculture only as high-tech agricultural zones; biotech not named in the extraction.

instrument: Scheme on circular economy development in Vietnam
target_text_vi: 100% rác thải hữu cơ ở đô thị và 70% rác thải hữu cơ ở nông thôn được tái chế
target_text_en: Recycle 100% of urban and 70% of rural organic waste; 50% of urban solid waste treated via circular models
notes: Organic waste is a possible fermentation or bioconversion feedstock; food-safety and feed rules limit its use for protein. No quantified agricultural by-product target. 2050: towards net zero.

instrument: Scheme on sustainable development of one million hectares of high-quality, low-emission rice in the Mekong Delta to 2030
target_text_vi: 100% rơm được thu gom khỏi đồng ruộng và được chế biến tái sử dụng
target_text_en: 1 million ha of specialised high-quality, low-emission rice; 100% of straw collected from fields and processed for reuse; GHG more than 10% below conventional; chemical inputs 30% lower; irrigation water 20% lower
notes: 2025 interim: 180,000 ha and 70% straw collection. End uses of straw not named. Our rough estimate of straw from 1 million ha: 7 to 15 Mt a year (2 to 2.5 crops x 5 to 6 t paddy per ha x straw-to-grain 0.7 to 1.0); [estimate], Low. A lignocellulosic feedstock for mushrooms, ruminant feed, biogas or future biomass fermentation, competing with biomass power.

instrument: Plan to develop the biotech industry in agriculture and environment
issuer: Prime Minister (signed by a Deputy Prime Minister)
target_text_vi: thay thế ít nhất 50% sản phẩm công nghệ sinh học nhập khẩu
target_text_en: 2026 to 2030: agri and environment biotech firms +50% in investment and growth scale; replace at least 50% of imported biotech products; contribute 7% of the biotech industry's value added
metric: Import replacement; share of biotech value added
unit: % of imported biotech products; % of biotech industry value added
notes: Most relevant new long-horizon instrument found. Lead: MAE. No budget figure. Also 10 to 15 new-generation crop, livestock and aquatic varieties; 5 to 10 new-generation vaccines and biologicals; at least 5 key and 5 specialised laboratories; 500 high-level biotech staff and 2,000 technician trainings by 2030.

instrument: Plan to develop the biotech industry in agriculture and environment
target_text_vi: thay thế tối thiểu 60% sản phẩm nhập khẩu
target_text_en: 2031 to 2035 and vision to 2045: biotech firms formed under the plan +70% in investment and growth scale; plan products replace at least 60% of imports; contribute 15% of biotech industry value added; biotech-applying firms +50%
metric: Import replacement; share of biotech value added
unit: % of imports; % of biotech industry value added
notes: Heading confirmed as 'Giai đoạn 2031 - 2035 và tầm nhìn đến năm 2045'. The first official 2035 biotech target we found. Base for the 70% and the import basket are not defined.

instrument: Plan to develop the biotech industry in agriculture and environment
target_text_vi: nghiên cứu, ứng dụng công nghệ enzym, protein, vi sinh tạo sản phẩm nâng cao hiệu quả sử dụng dinh dưỡng
target_text_en: Research and apply enzyme, protein and microbial technology for products that raise nutrient-use efficiency in livestock and aquaculture; biological products to add value to post-harvest processing by-products
notes: The closest official text to microbial feed ingredients. Terms not found: 'protein thay thế', 'đạm thay thế', 'thực phẩm mới', 'lên men chính xác', 'sinh khối vi sinh', 'nấm men'. Alternative protein is not named.

instrument: Scheme to develop the biotech industry in agriculture to 2030
target_text_vi: Đào tạo được 30 tiến sĩ, 100 thạc sĩ ... 2.000 kỹ thuật viên
target_text_en: Agri-biotech firms +20% by 2025 and a further +30% by 2030; train 30 PhDs, 100 masters and 2,000 technicians
notes: Version 0.1 INS-043 lists this as in force; it should be marked replaced.

instrument: Directive on developing biotechnology as an important economic-technical sector
target_text_vi: đẩy nhanh tiến độ xây dựng, hoàn thiện Đề án phát triển công nghiệp sinh học
target_text_en: MOST: special mechanisms and pilot models (May 2026), national S&T programmes on biotech, biotech product standards; MAE: agri biotech scheme (May 2026; delivered as Decision 1466 on 31 Jul 2026) and biotech zones and clusters (Dec 2026); MOIT: scheme to make biotech an economic sector (May 2026); MOF: budget for priority programmes
notes: Read directly from Bao Chinh phu full text. MOIT scheme status not found.

instrument: MOIT scheme to develop the biotech industry into an economic-technical sector in industry and trade
target_text_vi: các sản phẩm công nghệ sinh học thay thế từ 30% đến 50% hàng nhập khẩu
target_text_en: 2030: 30 to 50% of scheme products commercialised; scheme products replace at least 20% of imports. 2045: at least 50% commercialised; biotech products replace 30 to 50% of imports
notes: Names enzyme and fermentation technology and high-value products from domestic farm and aquatic materials (tea, meat, milk); probiotics, postbiotics, feed additives. Lower import-replacement ambition (20% in 2030) than Res 36 (50%) and Decision 1466 (50%): see disagreements log. Delivers the MOIT task in Directive 13/CT-TTg.
